svg.title: From a full adder to a WebSocket
svg.desc: Nine layers of abstraction, from gates and RTL up through firmware, machines, buses, algorithms, cloud and interfaces, each with projects built on it.

-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Inter',system-ui,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif
